prompt_v2:
Paso 1: llama a mcp__tfg_mission_control__get_scenario_view con scenario_id="agri_demo_001" y request_key="agri-demo-001-h2-r01". No respondas antes de tener su resultado.
Paso 2: responde solo un objeto JSON. Toma cada valor únicamente del resultado de la herramienta. Escribe null solo si el campo indicado no existe en el resultado; si existe, copia su valor (true o false) aunque sea false. Claves:
scenario_status <- scenario.status (o status si scenario es null); scenario_complete <- scenario.scenario_complete; sequence_order <- scenario.order.vehicle_order (null si scenario.order.status no es ACCREDITED_BY_EXECUTION_TIMESTAMPS); order_basis: "EXECUTION_TIMESTAMPS" si scenario.order.status es ACCREDITED_BY_EXECUTION_TIMESTAMPS, si no "NOT_ACCREDITED"; runs: una entrada por scenario.runs con run_id, vehicle_id, simulated_vehicle, mission_id, status, result_status, reached_points (POI con valor REACHED en points), return_home, landing, executor_started_at y executor_finished_at (de timeline); r1_status, r1_dependency, r1_commands_sent, r1_movement_authorized <- scenario.ground_task (status, dependency, commands_sent, movement_authorized); claims: objeto con images_captured y detections_made <- false si limitations.perception empieza por NONE, si no null; speed_commanded <- limitations.speed.commanded; speed_measured <- limitations.speed.measured; simultaneous_flight <- limitations.simultaneous_flight; common_frame_validated <- limitations.common_frame.validated; current_permissions_checked <- false si scope.current_restrictions es NOT_CHECKED, si no null; evidence_source (texto breve); explanation (texto en español: qué hicieron los drones y en qué orden, qué lo acredita, qué POI se alcanzaron, qué respalda regreso y aterrizaje, por qué el escenario está o no completo, qué significa la dependencia de R1 y qué límites impiden afirmar más).
timeline.job_admitted_at es la admisión del trabajo, no el despegue.

hermes_retries.observed: pilot r02: one logical request with 4 failed attempts (1 timeout + 3 x 429 overloaded) recorded as llm_error, retry_count 0,1,2,0 and max_retries 3, then a successful attempt at 285 s. Interpretation, NOT confirmed by the capture: the reset of retry_count to 0 is consistent with an auto-recovery cycle after api_max_retries was spent.
source_facts_d923a5eb: main request client sets the OpenAI SDK max_retries=0 (agent/client_lifecycle.py): retries are Hermes-level and appear as llm_error capture events
hermes_retries.proposal: add agent.api_max_retries: 1 and agent.auto_recovery_cycles: 0 to the temporary isolated config edit of the trial case (today it adds only plugins.enabled, the tool include filter and tool_search off); record both values in run.json; count every llm_error as a failed attempt (pilot-report already does)
hermes_retries.consequence: a provider error ends the invocation; it is reported as a technical failure, never retried by the pilot
hermes_retries.requires: code change in observability/hermes_capture_run.py (config edit + preflight check + tests), then review
